security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Things-style task manager that syncs with Things Cloud
bundle.longDescription: Tings 3 is an unofficial Windows task manager inspired by Things 3. It reads and, after explicit opt-in, writes your Things Cloud data so it stays in sync with Things on iPhone.
